Static view-only coverage belongs to the keep among the audited building candidates. All 1,814 pixels have exact mesh-backed coverage; the recovered 92 triangles are identical across all four combinations of appearance-1 and appearance-2. The receiving anchor is on verified ground. No character/projectile boundaries, obstacle links or patch mask references are present. Exact coverage follows an independent one-pixel eastward move.

The keep owns the complete initial mask and sight set of patch 5. Coverage is supported by its mesh, and linked roof obstacles 283, 287 and 288 are local parts. Character thresholds use the flat receiving floor of part 280 at height 140.001; projectile thresholds retain world XY. The receiving anchor is the patch waypoint lifted onto that floor. There are no movement changes or door links.

Every character boundary point receives on the keep-owned flat 140.001-unit surface (building-280). Full coverage is supported by this asset mesh; linked obstacles have one local owner and no patch controls the mask. Projectile boundaries use the world XY datum.
